items.name: tuscan-villa-driveway
items.text: The grand, cypress-lined gravel driveway leading to a classic Tuscan villa made of warm, weathered stone, set within a landscape of rolling hills and orderly rows of grapevines.

items.name: modern-mansion-driveway
items.text: The driveway of a large, generic modern mansion with a manicured lawn and high privacy hedges.

items.name: hollywood-hills-mansion
items.text: The perfectly manicured driveway of a modern, minimalist glass-and-steel mansion in the Hollywood Hills overlooking the sprawling Los Angeles basin.

items.name: castle-forecourt
items.text: The grand forecourt of a historic castle estate like Neuschwanstein, framed by tall stone walls and dramatic, forested alpine topography.

items.name: yacht-harbor-dock
items.text: A clean wooden dock in an exclusive yacht harbor, lined with mooring posts and coiled ropes.

items.name: private-airstrip
items.text: A private desert airstrip beside an open jet hangar, heat shimmering off the apron and a business jet waiting behind.

items.name: infinity-pool-terrace
items.text: A clifftop infinity-pool terrace, the water edge dissolving seamlessly into the sea horizon beyond.

items.name: grand-hotel-portico
items.text: The lantern-lit portico of a grand belle-époque hotel, brass luggage carts and a red carpet under the columns.

items.name: alpine-lodge-drive
items.text: The snow-banked drive of an exclusive alpine lodge, warm windows glowing against dusk-blue peaks.

items.name: winery-estate
items.text: A vineyard estate forecourt, modern winery architecture rising from rows of vines on rolling hills.

items.name: gated-entrance
items.text: Monumental wrought-iron estate gates between stone piers, clipped topiary and a curving drive beyond.

items.name: cliff-glass-house
items.text: A minimalist glass house cantilevered over a cliff edge, ocean horizon running the full width of the facade.

items.name: stone-farmhouse-court
items.text: The gravel court of a restored stone farmhouse, lavender borders and weathered oak shutters.

items.name: manor-circular-driveway
items.text: An old-world manor with a grand circular driveway, marble statuary and sculpted hedges ringing the fountain.

items.name: lakeside-estate-dock
items.text: A private lakeside estate dock, contemporary mansion and shoreline trees doubled in still water.

items.name: beachfront-villa
items.text: A lavish beachfront villa forecourt, palm shadows across pale stone and turquoise water beyond the dunes.
